summary: Full stack testing of VJ Kinetic Type Engine MVP. Backend scenes CRUD (POST/GET/GET-by-id/PUT/DELETE + 404 cases) verified with 8 pytest tests - all passing. Frontend flows verified via Playwright on public URL: two-line vs one-line text rendering with ';', all 5 aspect ratio buttons, Transform tab sliders + reset, FX tab preset toggles (wave/pulse/glitch) revealing speed/amp sliders, Font tab list + search + selection, Text tab color pickers + uppercase + align buttons, Scenes tab end-to-end save/apply/delete against backend, fullscreen/popout buttons, /output clean route rendering VisualStage via BroadcastChannel/localStorage. All checks passed.
critical_code_review_comments: api.js has no updateScene() wrapper for PUT /api/scenes/{id} even though backend supports it - fine for MVP since the UI only creates/deletes, but consider adding for future edit-scene UX.
sanitizeConfig strips media.clips before persisting; that is correct because clip URLs are blob:// URLs. Consider surfacing this in UI so users know clips are not saved with a scene.
Studio.jsx BroadcastChannel is created twice (line 51 and line 59 fallback); harmless but slightly redundant.
No pagination on GET /api/scenes (hardcoded to 200 docs); acceptable for MVP but note the ceiling.
seed_data_creation: Test scenes prefixed with TEST_ created and cleaned up during pytest run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test file is at /app/backend/tests/test_scenes.py. Media clip upload (blob) and custom font upload are browser-only per spec and were not exercised end-to-end. If retesting, note that scenes persist across runs unless the TEST_ cleanup fixture runs.
